en.descricao:
About the role
We are hiring a Senior Data Analyst to own our sales reporting.
Requirements:
- Advanced SQL
- Power BI or Tableau
- Fluent English
- At least 4 hours of overlap with US Eastern Time
About the contract
This is a B2B contractor engagement paid in USD. We sponsor visas for candidates who later relocate.
Remote-first, but you will join the team in our Austin office 2 days a week during onboarding.
How to apply
Please send a cover letter and a link to your portfolio. Shortlisted candidates complete a take-home exercise.
